name: DP Websolutions Login Branding
author: Jason Sindram

sections.description:
DP Websolutions Login Branding automatically detects your logo and theme colors from Astra, Divi, Elementor and modern block themes.

Features:
* Automatic logo detection
* Theme color detection
* Astra support
* Divi support
* Elementor support
* Block theme support
* Lightweight and focused
* A small set of focused options

Uninstall

When the plugin is deleted, DP Websolutions Login Branding removes only its own Customizer theme-mod settings.
It does not delete your WordPress site logo, uploaded media files, theme settings, Elementor data, Astra settings, Divi settings, or WordPress global styles.

Asset Licensing

The bundled assets assets/dp-logo.webp and assets/qr-code.png were created and are owned by DP Websolutions.
They are licensed under GPLv2 or later together with this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin
  2. Activate plugin
  3. Go to Appearance → Login Screen
  4. Customize if desired
sections.faq:
Which colors are used first?

Supports Astra, Divi, Elementor and modern WordPress block themes.

When supported builder colors are available, they take priority over theme colors.

DP Websolutions Login Branding checks Elementor Global Colors first, then supported theme colors from Astra and Divi, then WordPress Global Styles. If no supported colors are detected, safe fallback colors are used.

Additional builders and themes may be supported in future versions.

0.6.8

  • Added plugin default support to Button & accent color
  • Improved Customizer grouping and color control copy

0.5.8

  • Added Elementor secondary Global Color detection
  • Prioritized supported builder and active-theme colors before block-theme fallbacks
  • Added detected branding source information to the plugin settings page

0.5.6

  • Improved login control contrast and keyboard focus visibility
  • Limited global style detection to the active theme
  • Improved translation readiness

0.5.5
